description: Tool to retrieve a list of scheduled Calendly events. Use when you need to view events for a specific user, organization, or group. Provide one scope parameter, or organization plus user or group to list that member's or group's events as an organization admin/owner. Use user alone for your own personal events.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving a list of scheduled events.

count.description: Number of events to return per page. Must be a positive integer.
count.title: Count

group.description: Full Calendly API URI of the group (team) whose events you want to list. MUST be a complete URI in the format 'https://api.calendly.com/groups/{uuid}'. Use alone with organization admin/owner or group admin privilege. Organization admins/owners can also provide `organization` to list this group's events within it.
group.title: Group

invitee_email.description: Return events that are scheduled with the invitee associated with this email address. This is a filter parameter and must be used together with one of the scope parameters (user, organization, or group).
invitee_email.title: Invitee Email

max_start_time.description: Include events with start times prior to this time. Must be in UTC format (ISO 8601).
max_start_time.title: Max Start Time

min_start_time.description: Include events with start times after this time. Must be in UTC format (ISO 8601).
min_start_time.title: Min Start Time

organization.description: Full Calendly API URI of the organization whose events you want to list. MUST be a complete URI in the format 'https://api.calendly.com/organizations/{uuid}'. Use alone for organization events, with `user` for that member's events, or with `group` for that group's events. Requires organization admin/owner privilege.
organization.title: Organization

page_token.description: Pagination token to retrieve a specific page of results. Use the 'next_page_token' from a previous response to get the next page.
page_token.title: Page Token

sort.description: Order results by the specified field and direction. Format: 'field:direction'. Supported field: 'start_time'. Supported directions: 'asc' (ascending), 'desc' (descending).
sort.title: Sort

status.description: Filter events by their status. Can be 'active' for active events or 'canceled' for canceled events.
status.title: Status

user.description: Full Calendly API URI of the user whose events you want to list. MUST be a complete URI in the format 'https://api.calendly.com/users/{uuid}'. Shortcuts like 'me' are NOT supported - use CALENDLY_GET_CURRENT_USER to get the user URI first. Use `user` alone for your own events. To list another user's events within your organization, also provide `organization` (requires organization admin/owner privilege).
user.title: User
